title: Rumor mill: is Pallo about to sign Hartwell?
text: Unnamed sources suggest... Pallo Systems is said to be close to a deal with Hartwell Logistics as a fulfillment-center partner. We could not reach either company for comment. Treat as speculation.

facts.statement: Pallo Systems is said to be close to a deal with Hartwell Logistics as its fulfillment-center partner.
